_comment: Edit the 'yours' block for your own machine. Every value there is an [ASSUMPTION] until you replace it; the lab measures power, throughput and busy fraction itself. The 'orion' block is Chapter 21's model (Sections 21.1 and 21.4) and should not be edited.

yours.hardware_note: purchase price of the machine the GPU lives in; a laptop GPU cannot be bought on its own
yours.electricity_note: the book's tariff; replace with your own
yours.host_power_note: non-GPU power (CPU, display, fans); nvidia-smi sees only the GPU board, so 0 means GPU-board energy only
yours.allocated_note: share of owned hours the GPU runs your jobs: 0.25 = 6 hours a day
